editorial:
Imagine living on a tiny, lonely island where your only neighbors are your own sisters. That is exactly where you find our three main characters. They each have their own little house and their own way of doing things, but they are not exactly getting along. The whole vibe is quirky and a bit sad, but it mostly feels like a funny look at how family members can drive each other crazy even when there is nowhere else to go. You will quickly feel for these sisters as they try to navigate their strange, isolated lives while dealing with their old arguments.

What really makes this work is the animation style and the way the story slowly builds up. The pacing is steady, and the humor comes from the awkward situations they get into when they finally have to let a stranger into their world. If you like stories about weird families, you will love this. To get the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the art details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night. It is a great pick for a rainy Sunday.
endingExplained: The story wraps up when the sisters finally realize that their bond is more important than their petty fights. After the stress of renting out the house, they stop hiding in their separate homes and start acting like a family again. The final scenes show them coming together and finding peace on their island. It is a sweet ending that shows how opening up to others can fix old wounds and stop the loneliness.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky family stories and beautiful animation.
